With maximum_repair_rounds=1 the loop stopped at 2 model calls; two extra scripted replies remained unconsumed (ScriptedTransport raises on any extra send).

Crash before the round-boundary commit; restart resumed at the same frontier, consumed the persisted response once (still 2 provider sends total), completed rounds [0,1], selected round 1, and kept recorded spend (model_calls 2, tokens 240/60).
